_comment: Shape of the SITES secret. Copy to sites.json (gitignored), fill in real values, then: wrangler secret put SITES < sites.json. The key is the site's origin exactly as the browser sends it — scheme, host, no trailing slash, and one entry per domain the site answers on (with and without www if both are live).
